schema.description: Request body for Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3 Max text-to-video model on fal (blackforestlabs/flux-3-max/text-to-video): generate a video with audio from a text prompt.

example.prompt: A red panda walks along a mossy log in a sunlit forest. Ambient birdsong.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. auto is 16:9 for a text prompt and follows the first image otherwise.

duration.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds, 5 to 20. fal bills per second of this value.

generate_audio.description: Generate synchronized audio. The price is the same.

prompt.description: Text prompt that describes the video and its sound.

reasoning_level.description: How much the model reasons about and expands the prompt before generation. high is slower. The price is the same.

resolution.description: Resolution of the generated video. 1080p costs more per second than 720p.

seed.description: Random seed. A random seed is selected when omitted.
